record.field: WITH principal AS ( SELECT mml.code as A, it.dian_code as B, rp.vat as C, rp.lastname1 as D, rp.lastname2 as E, rp.name1 as F, rp.name2 as G, rp.name as H, rp.street as I, rcs.dian_code as J, SUBSTRING(rcsc.dian_code, 3) as K, rc.medios_code as L, rp.email as M, (CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'N' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN SUM(aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'N' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN SUM(aml.credit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'N' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN SUM(aml.debit-aml.credit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'N' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN SUM(aml.tax_base_amount) END ) as N, (CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'O' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN SUM(aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'O' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN SUM(aml.credit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'O' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN SUM(aml.debit-aml.credit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'O' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN SUM(aml.tax_base_amount) END ) as O FROM mag_media mm INNER JOIN mag_media_lines mml ON mml.magnetic_id = mm.id INNER JOIN mag_media_lines_concepts mmlc ON mmlc.line_id = mml.id INNER JOIN ( select aammlcr.account_account_id as account_id, aammlcr.mag_media_lines_concepts_id as concept_id from account_account_mag_media_lines_concepts_rel aammlcr union all select aaat.account_account_id as account_id, mmlcaat.concept_ids as concept_id from mag_media_lines_concepts_account_account_tag mmlcaat inner join account_account_tag aat on aat.id = mmlcaat.tag_ids inner join account_account_account_tag aaat on aaat.account_account_tag_id = aat.id ) AS aa ON aa.concept_id = mmlc.id INNER JOIN account_move_line aml ON aml.account_id = aa.account_id LEFT JOIN res_partner rp ON rp.id = aml.partner_id LEFT JOIN l10n_latam_identification_type it ON it.id = rp.l10n_latam_identification_type_id LEFT JOIN res_country_state rcs ON rcs.id = rp.state_id LEFT JOIN res_city rcsc ON rcsc.id = rp.city_id LEFT JOIN res_country rc ON rc.id = rp.country_id WHERE mm.id = {id} AND aml.date BETWEEN '{date_from}' AND '{date_to}' AND aml.parent_state = 'posted' AND aml.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY mml.code, it.dian_code, rp.vat, rp.name1, rp.name2, rp.lastname1, rp.lastname2, rp.name, rp.street, rcs.dian_code, rcsc.dian_code, rc.medios_code, rp.email, mmlc.sequence, mmlc.type, mm.smaller_amount ) SELECT A as "Concepto", B as "Tipo documento", C as "Número de identificación de informado", D as "Primer apellido del informado", E as "Segundo apellido del informado", F as "Primer nombre del informado", G as "Segundo nombre del informado", H as "Nombre informado", I as "Dirección", J as "Código departamento", K as "Código municipio", L as "Código país", M as "Correo electronico", SUM(N) as "Pago o abono en cuenta deducible", SUM(O) as "Pago o abono en cuenta no deducible" FROM principal GROUP BY A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M ORDER BY A, B, C
